settings.title: URINAL SPLASH MAT
settings.text:
Maximum Coverage, Minimum Hassle: Designed to prevent puddling under urinals, Splash Mats provide industry-leading coverage with a unique 21” x 20” size.

Unmatched Odor Control: Featuring the highest content of anti-microbial and silver elements, Splash Mats ensure superior odor control, maintaining a fresh restroom environment.

Stain-Resistant and Quick-Drying: Stain-resistant, quick-drying mats made from 100% recycled material. Latex rubber backing prevents folds, expedites moisture evaporation.

settings.title: SINK & TOWEL MATS
settings.text:
Anti-Microbial Defense: Powerful antimicrobial fibers prevent the growth and spread of bacteria, creating a hygienic and inviting restroom environment.

Efficient Water Management: Polypropylene fibers suspend water for quick air drying, ensuring a consistently dry and safe surface, eliminating slip hazards and soggy mats.

Odor-Neutralizing Freshness: Quickly dries and neutralizes odor-causing enzymes, maintaining a fresh restroom free from mold or mildew scents.

settings.subtitle: URINAL MAT
settings.title: CLEAN SHIELD
settings.text:
Odor-Free Protection: Treated with anti-microbial properties, ensuring reduced odors and quick air drying to maintain clean and safe restroom floors.

Seep Guard Technology: Seep Guard technology prevents liquid seepage, ensuring mats adhere securely to the floor.

User-Friendly Maintenance: 30-day time strip aids janitorial scheduling, paired with eco-friendly PET fabric for enhanced restroom aesthetics.
